about: Colours of the weather forecast images, read by pipelines/weather_forecasts/raster.py to paint them and by the frontend legend to draw them, so the two cannot differ. Values are interpolated linearly between the stops. Precipitation runs from 0 to the run's scale_max_mm (weather manifest) and hides cells under min_visible_mm; temperature and wind use the fixed ranges in scales, which are display ranges chosen to cover the Sierra Nevada from valleys to summits.
